answer: The sparrow schedule is applied in grove and karst publishes each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and therefore 36% arrives at settlement and the rest over 11 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4729 identities would post 1776 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
